nom: Perricone MD High Potency Face Finishing & Firming Tinted Moisturizer SPF 30

segments.dry: Reviewers with dry skin report the moisturizer feels hydrating, with some using it as a top layer over a richer moisturizer during particularly dry or flaky periods.
segments.sensitive: Most reviewers with sensitive skin report no breakouts or irritation, though one reviewer's very sensitive skin broke out even though the same product worked well on a family member.
segments.mature: One reviewer with mature skin appreciates the sheer, buildable tint that avoids looking cakey with only light coverage.

concerns.aging: The moisturizer is marketed with a firming claim, but most reviewers say they did not notice any visible firming effect even after weeks of use; a smaller number report their skin feels tighter or smoother, especially around the jawline.
concerns.dehydration: Reviewers with dry skin generally find it hydrating and describe it melting into the skin, though a couple with drier skin say they still need a heavier moisturizer underneath or prefer using it as a top layer rather than their main moisturizer.
concerns.blemishes: Most reviewers report no breakouts or clogged pores, but one reviewer with very sensitive skin experienced breakouts from the formula even though it worked well on a family member's skin.
concerns.spots: Reviewers using it over dark spots, melasma or sun damage report the tint and mineral SPF visibly even out discoloration and scars over time.

aspects.libelle: Pleasant, subtle floral or rose scent
Tint can turn orange on very fair skin
Whipped, lightweight texture that blends easily
Tint is very sheer with minimal color payoff
Reduces the need for separate foundation

extraits.texte: I love that this product comes in a glass container. It has good smooth texture and looks great on my skin. I have very sensitive skin so this was making me break out, however it's does really well on my husband. It's a very light tint so even he didn't notice. It's a pricey product but if you don't have sensitive skin I would get it.

I like the moisture level a lot, it is very hydrating for dry skin in the winter. However, the tint is very Orange toned, which I do not like. The color accentuates texture or lines and ends up looking quite patchy. I was hoping to use it alone with no additional makeup on top but that isn't possible.

Nice moisturizer with a slight tint. I love a good tinted moisturizer so I was thrilled to get this and try it. As much as I loved the tint aspect the moisturizer itself wasn't a home run for me. I have dry sensitive skin from living in the desert and this just doesn't have the staying power that I need. Would still recommend this to friends not living in my area, great product, I just needed more is all.

Perricone MD High Potency Face Finishing & Firming Tinted Moisturizer (30 SPF) is a lightweight, fast-absorbing, deeply-hydrating and moisturizing mineral based tinted sunscreen which provides protection from solar and blue-light (from electronics) UV rays. Having melasma and dark spots my dermatologist first and foremost treatment is tinted sunscreen. However, this one provides a dewy natural-looking luminous pearlescence, and illuminating glow unlike other hazy white film tinted sunscreens. It immediately hydrates, and begins repairing with its antioxidants such as: alpha lipoic acid, Bisabolol, which aids in reducing the appearance of lines, wrinkles and increases collagen and elastin production. Before and after shows hand scar that is quite less visible after applying moisturizer. Would recommend 10/10.

extraits.titre: Amazing for dry uneven skin tone
extraits.texte: This is the best thing that's happened to my skin in months! As I'm sure many people have, I've been experiencing incredibly dry flaky skin due to the wind and cold. This tinted moisturizer has magic in it because after applying, it sort of melts into my skin, creating this beautiful, "my skin, but not blotchy" canvas. Lately I'm not wearing much more than this and some concealer. I don't have to fuss..it lasts, and doesn't feel greasy or heavy. I'm off to Florida this coming week, and I love that this product is not only a fabulous tinted moisturizer, but also contains SPF30! Gorgeous, and I will re-buy!

I absolutely love this moisturizer. I started using it years ago and will never switch! I have very sensitive skin and this never causes me any issues. A little goes a long way. Despite using this daily, I find that it lasts me several months. I'm not a person that uses makeup and the tint in this is perfect. It's really smooth and hydrating, leaving my skin looking glowy and fresh. It helps even out my skin, absorbs well, protects, and doesn't look "fake" or like makeup. Would recommend to anyone!
